plan.goal: The library's whitespace-insensitive bigram similarity gives inconsistent scores for non-ASCII text. For example, the strings éa and éab share one of three total scalar-value bigrams and should score 2/3. Diagnose and repair the Unicode behavior. Count Unicode scalar-value bigrams, preserve duplicate multiplicity, whitespace removal, equal-input behavior and existing ASCII behavior. Unequal inputs with fewer than two scalars after whitespace removal score zero. Preserve existing APIs.
hypotheses: In src/lib.rs, sorensen_dice removes whitespace and forms duplicate-counted (char,char) bigrams correctly, but uses String::len() for the fewer-than-two guard and Sørensen–Dice denominator. String::len() counts UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII inputs can bypass/trigger the guard incorrectly and produce byte-based scores. The repair review computes a_len and b_len with chars().count() after whitespace removal and uses those scalar counts in both places. Equal-input behavior, whitespace removal, duplicate multiplicity, ASCII behavior, and public APIs remain unchanged. Uncertainty: no behavioral/compiler checks have run because discovery must stop at checkpoint.
